instructions: Every E2E test added after the baseline must be documented in the current release section or explicitly classified as internal with a concrete reason.

reviews.test: shows the transfer and listing restriction badge only for confirmed EX items
evidence: EX属性を示す譲渡・出品不可情報

reviews.test: shows the confirmed masterbook on recipe item labels
evidence: 製作に必要な秘伝書名

reviews.test: shows one selectable search row per recipe variant and uses the selected ingredients
evidence: 検索結果へ製作方法ごとに表示

reviews.test: loads all recipe variants from the published item data
evidence: 同じアイテムに複数の製作方法

reviews.test: offers the same recipe selector for an intermediate item in the tree and materials list
evidence: レシピツリーと素材リストから使用する製作方法を選択

reviews.test: creates a named favorite list from a tree pin and exports a compact share code
evidence: 従来より短くなる形式

reviews.test: converts v2 favorite storage to v3 and removes v2 only after saving it
round-trips a selected recipe through the compact favorite share code
evidence: 製作方法を保存し、素材計算やシェアコードへ反映

reviews.test: uses the favorite list recipe selection for its material calculation
evidence: 製作方法を保存し、素材計算やシェアコードへ反映

reviews.test: automatically saves a recipe method that minimizes craft job changes
evidence: 製作ジョブの切り替えが少なくなる製作方法を自動選択

reviews.test: finalizes missing legacy recipe methods when restoring a favorite list
evidence: 製作方法の情報がない旧形式のお気に入りやシェアコード

reviews.test: keeps different recipe selections when summing multiple favorite lists
evidence: 選択した製作方法を保存し、素材計算

reviews.test: restores left and right scroll positions after reload
reviews.reason: This restoration safeguard is intentionally omitted from the concise v2.95 user release notes.

reviews.test: single-column shop dialog stays compact at six hundred pixels and expands only for multiple columns
evidence: 店舗数と画面幅に応じて見やすい列数と横幅

reviews.test: bulk purchase controls are collapsible and synchronize disabled state
evidence: 中間素材の購入指定を、それぞれ一括で指定・解除

reviews.test: search result selection preserves applicable purchase flags
reviews.reason: This is a state-preservation regression safeguard for existing purchase controls.

reviews.test: favorite child count changes preserve the list scroll position
evidence: 個数を変更すると、アイテム一覧のスクロール位置が最上部へ戻る問題

reviews.test: multiple rings show production bulk controls and preserve purchases when counts change
evidence: 指輪の必要数と中間素材の購入指定を、それぞれ一括で指定・解除

reviews.test: equipment search reset clears only the conditions
evidence: 装備検索のリセットで、検索条件以外

reviews.test: equipment search maximum item level never decreases as equipment level rises
evidence: 装備検索の全対象ジョブ
最大アイテムレベルが下がる
